title: Alice plans a spring trip to Kyoto
content: On 2026-04-02 (UTC) Alice told the assistant she is planning a trip to Kyoto in late April 2026 to see the last of the cherry blossoms. She said she prefers staying in a traditional ryokan over a hotel and asked for quiet areas near the Philosopher's Path. The assistant suggested the Higashiyama district and noted that ryokan there book out weeks ahead in spring.
